description: testdata/ holds Compose files that are test inputs (images such as localhost:5000/db that exist nowhere), not this repository's dependencies. Scoped to the docker-compose manager so that testdata/wasm/labapp/go.mod, the test guest's real Go dependencies, stays updated. ignorePaths is not mergeable: the list repeats config:recommended's (:ignoreModulesAndTests) and adds testdata.
